title: Spyglass is Live: Unlock Powerful New Perspectives
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing you with a powerful new tool to gain clearer and more comprehensive insights.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your files with a new, intuitive interface that gives you direct control to add, remove, download, and customize how embedded media appears in your editor.

title: Introducing Our Interactive Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap offers complete transparency, showcasing what we've delivered and what exciting features are on the horizon.

title: Elevated Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and efficient workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now boasting improved clickability, drag-and-drop functionality, and a modern design.

title: Seamless Collaboration Experience
summary: Experience smoother real-time teamwork with clearer insights into shared documents and team activity.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: Discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests more easily with enhanced visibility, ensuring you always have access to the content that matters most from your connections.

title: Expanded Global Language Support
summary: Our latest update introduces comprehensive support for international languages, empowering users worldwide to experience Noeko in their native tongue.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, transparency, and the ability to directly contribute to its evolution.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate and activate your knowledge with an upgraded Constellation view, featuring powerful new filters and collaborative insights to make your most valuable information shine.

title: Advanced Search and Custom Views
summary: Unlock precise knowledge discovery with powerful filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to save tailored search views for quick and easy access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews & Layouts
summary: Elevate your note-taking experience with flexible new layouts and interactive content previews, making it easier than ever to visualize and organize your connected ideas.

title: Unlock More Power with Noeko Self-Hosting and Enterprise Plans
summary: We are excited to introduce flexible deployment options and premium plans for Noeko, empowering you with greater control and access to advanced features tailored for your team.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Refined Classics
summary: Experience a fresh new look with vibrant new themes and beautifully refined classics, offering more ways to customize your workspace.

title: More Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the perfect time-of-day message for a consistently personalized and accurate experience.

title: Enhanced Tag Management with Direct Actions
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by directly unapplying or removing items from any tag's list, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate and engage with a wider variety of content formats, including videos, websites, and text, to build an even richer and more comprehensive knowledge base.
